summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the Dark Swiss theme UI overhaul. All features are working correctly including the 3-column layout, dark theme (neutral-950 background), Project Info section, Internal Team with Hours/Utilization toggle, Vendors with cost/markup calculation, Pricing Settings with Split Margins, Template Loader, and real-time Dashboard.
